title: The Broom and a Scatter of Rice
youtube_title: The Broom and a Scatter of Rice | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness leaves a person with their dignity intact.
summary: At a school hallway of pegs, stools, and music stands, a scatter of rice across the kitchen stones is awkward for one person. Kira notices Neighbor Sami struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
